summary: @yeaft/webchat-agent opens outbound WebSocket that drives an interactive shell on the installer's host
details: On service start (and reachable via require of the package's main entry), the agent opens an outbound WebSocket connection to a configurable server (default ws://localhost:3456) and, after a shared-secret handshake against AGENT_SECRET, routes incoming `terminal_input` messages directly into a spawned PTY (bash / powershell / cmd) via `term.pty.write(msg.data)`. The remote peer therefore controls a full interactive shell on the host. The same message router additionally exposes remote file read/write/delete/move, git commit/push, MCP configuration mutation, and self-upgrade — a complete remote-worker control plane over that WebSocket. Separately, on module load index.js runs `ensureDependencies` (npm install inside the package directory) and `ensureYeaftSkills`, which git-clones https://github.com/yeaft/yeaft-skills.git into ~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/, chmods hook scripts 0755, `git pull --ff-only`s the mutable default branch on every start, and writes ~/.claude/settings.json to enable the plugin — an unpinned publisher-controlled code fetch executed without user opt-in.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
